CustomField.description: Percentage of an org limit at which AI Assist pauses new chat messages until usage falls back below this value minus the resume margin. Always above the degraded percentage. Blank or outside 2 to 100 falls back to 85.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: At this percentage of an org limit new chat messages are paused until usage falls. Default 85.
CustomField.label: Org Limit Paused Percent
